name: The majority voted against a motion introduced by Calare MP [Andrew Gee](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/calare/andrew_gee) (Independent), which means it failed. ### Motion text > *That so much of the standing and sessional orders be suspended as would prevent the following from occurring immediately:* > > *(1) the Member for Calare introducing the [Keeping Cash Transactions in Australia Bill](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7202); and* > > *(2) debate on the second reading of the bill proceeding for a period of no longer than one hour, after which any questions required to complete passage of the bill then being put without delay.* Standing and sessional orders are the usual procedural rules of parliament.
